title: DISTINCT 和 LIMIT 关键字

resolved.title: DISTINCT 关键字
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The DISTINCT Keyword[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

In situations in which you have multiple duplicate records in a table, it might make more sense to return only unique records, instead of fetching the duplicates.

The SQL [b]DISTINCT [/b]keyword is used in conjunction with SELECT to eliminate all duplicate records and return only unique ones.

[s0l0!-header][b]The basic syntax of DISTINCT is as follows:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="sql" ]SELECT [b]DISTINCT [/b]column_name1, column_name2
FROM table_name;[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]See the customers table below:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2796" width="100%"]
Note that there are duplicate [b]City [/b]names. The following SQL statement selects only distinct values from the City column: [code format="sql" codeId="3035"]SELECT [b]DISTINCT [/b]City FROM customers; [/code]
This would produce the following result. Duplicate entries have been removed. [img id="2797" width="100%"]
[note]The DISTINCT keyword only fetches the unique values.[/note]
[s0l0!-coach id="985" name="Customer Copies" xp="10" description="Write a query to show only the unique checks that are given to the customer." imageUrl="/content/assets/7681d672fb53ea4c00b8.png" button="Start" color=""]Practice what you've learned.[/s0l0!-coach]

content.text:
当一个表中有多条重复记录的时，只返回唯一的记录，而不是获取重复的记录，可能更有意义。

SQL **DISTINCT**关键字与**SELECT**结合使用，可以自动去的记录，返回唯一的记录。

**DISTINCT**的基本语法如下：
content.text_html:
In situations in which you have multiple duplicate records in a table, it might make more sense to return only unique records, instead of fetching the duplicates.

The SQL **DISTINCT **keyword is used in conjunction with SELECT to eliminate all duplicate records and return only unique ones.

The basic syntax of DISTINCT is as follows:

在一个表中有多条重复记录的情况下，只返回唯一的记录，而不是获取重复的记录，可能更有意义。

SQL **DISTINCT **关键字与SELECT结合使用，可以消除所有重复的记录，只返回唯一的记录。

DISTINCT的基本语法如下：。

content.content:
SELECT DISTINCT column_name1, column_name2
FROM table_name;

resolved.problem_statement_md:
在银行有一笔交易结束时，最终有6张支票(英文check)打印出来：
- 3张是银行的原件
- 3张是客户的副本

下图的操作记录表**Operation** 记录了该6张支票：

![](/content/assets/04dda43bede3b683e82c.jpeg)

请写一个查询，返回去重后的所有支票(列为`Checks`，大写).

resolved.title: LIMIT 关键字
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The LIMIT Keyword[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

By default, all results that satisfy the conditions specified in the SQL statement are returned. However, sometimes we need to retrieve just a subset of records. In MySQL, this is accomplished by using the [b]LIMIT [/b]keyword. 

[s0l0!-header][b]The syntax for LIMIT is as follows:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="sql" ]SELECT column list
FROM table_name
[b]LIMIT [/b][number of records];[/code]
For example, we can retrieve the first [b]five [/b]records from the [b]customers [/b]table.[code format="sql" codeId="3036"]SELECT ID, FirstName, LastName, City
FROM customers [b]LIMIT 5;[/b][/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]This would produce the following result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2798" width="100%"]
[note]By default, all results that satisfy the conditions specified in the SQL statement are returned.[/note]

默认情况下，所有满足SQL语句中指定条件的结果都会被返回。然而，有时我们只需要部分结果，而非全部。在MySQL中，可以通过使用**LIMIT**关键字来实现。

**LIMIT**的语法如下：
content.text_html:
By default, all results that satisfy the conditions specified in the SQL statement are returned. However, sometimes we need to retrieve just a subset of records. In MySQL, this is accomplished by using the **LIMIT **keyword.

The syntax for LIMIT is as follows:

默认情况下，所有满足SQL语句中指定条件的结果都会被返回。然而，有时我们需要只检索一个记录子集。在MySQL中，这可以通过使用**LIMIT **关键字来实现。

LIMIT的语法如下：。

resolved.title: LIMIT OFFSET 关键字
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The LIMIT Keyword[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You can also pick up a set of records from a particular [b]offset[/b].
In the following example, we pick up [b]four [/b]records, starting from the [b]third [/b]position:[code format="sql" codeId="3037"]SELECT ID, FirstName, LastName, City
 FROM customers [b]OFFSET[/b] 3 [b]LIMIT[/b] 4;[b][/b][/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]This would produce the following result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2799" width="100%"]
[note]The reason that it produces results starting from ID number four, and not three, is that MySQL starts counting from [b]zero[/b], meaning that the offset of the first row is 0, not 1.[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The LIMIT Keyword[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

content.text:

content.text_html:
You can also pick up a set of records from a particular offset. In the following example, we pick up **four **records, starting from the **third **position:

你也可以从一个特定的偏移点拾取一组记录。 在下面的例子中，我们从第个位开始，拾取四条**记录。

content.content:
SELECT ID, FirstName, LastName, City
FROM customers LIMIT 4 OFFSET 3;
